newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe's industrial index ends week firmer.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe's industrial index ends week firmer.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index ended firmer on Friday despite a poor showing most of the week, feeding on slight gains in a number of heavy-weight counters.
But brokers predicted the index would continue to be weighed down by investors' desertion of the bourse in favour of the local money market for more attractive short-term interest rates.
However on Friday the index gained 12.49 points to close at 10,296.10, although it lost 170.63 during the week.

Building and engineering firm Mashonaland Holdings added 10 cents to 235 while bankers Barclays, blue chip conglomerate Delta and wide-ranging manufacturing and marketing group Randalls all put on five cents to 3,230, 1,730 and 120 respectively.

In minings, gold producers Falgold and coal miners Wankie both traded at previous levels but copper company Mhangura shed two cents to 25. The seven-share index lost a minimal 0.19 to close at 958.10 though it edged up 3.78 points during the week.
